title: Level B2.2 French
description: Sequel to FRAN 181. Development of upper-intermediate language skills and intercultural competencies to achieve greater fluency and spontaneity, enabling effortless interactions with native speakers. Production of clear, detailed text and conversations on a wide range of concrete and abstract topics. Advances to a B2.2 level of the European Common Framework for Languages. Prepares for advanced (C1) study upon completion.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of FRAN 182, FRAN 180.
